subject: Set external variable value with custom function

messages.author: e302709dad51d37a
messages.subject: Set external variable value with custom function
parts:
Hi Inaki,

How would I successfully test a external variable's value using a custom function within the simulation?

Here's what I'm trying to do below:

rm(list = ls())

library(simmer)
library(dplyr)

test_line <- simmer('test line')

fill_speed <- 1

set_fill_speed <- function(.trj, var, val) {
  var <- val
}

test <- trajectory() %>%
  log_('started') %>%
  seize('filler') %>% log_('seized filler') %>% timeout(fill_speed) %>% release('filler') %>% log_('released filler') %>%
  set_fill_speed(fill_speed, 2) %>%
  log_('finished')

test_line %>%
  add_resource('filler') %>%
  add_generator('unit_', test, function() 1, mon = 2) %>%
  run(until = 10)


Let me know your thoughts!

Best,
John
